figures.title: The plant is assets joined by couplings
figures.caption: The toy plant has 11 assets, 21 ports and 13 couplings. Each coupling carries one domain of energy between ports on two assets. Energy changes domain only inside an asset, on a bond. The pump turns shaft power into fluid power.

figures.title: Grouping the plant into envelopes
figures.caption: The same plant grouped into 4 envelopes. 5 of the 13 couplings cross a boundary. In this toy model the groups were set by function. Finding them from coupling strength is not built yet.

figures.title: Each envelope becomes one asset
figures.caption: Each envelope folds into one block. Its ports are the ends of the 5 boundary couplings. The study below uses only the power on those couplings for the reduced model, and every port for the full model.

figures.title: A failure that crosses envelopes
figures.caption: Pulsation from the pump in envelope A travels the coupling P1.fluid → HX1.fluid (60 m, fluid) and the heat exchanger in envelope B reaches entropic endurance. The local band sensor and the reduced model are not the same on the source.
